note: Hand-written for the offline harness test. The text is original (no user data) and the three outputs are hand-written examples in the GradeResult shape, not responses captured from a model.
text:
Dear Mr. Lee,

I am writing to you about the parking problem in front of my house. Since last month, your car is parked in front of my driveway almost three times in a week. Yesterday I could not go to my work because your car was block the way, and I was late for a important meeting. My manager was not happy about that.

I understand that parking on our street is difficult, specially in the winter. However, I need to use my driveway every morning at 7:30. Could you please park on the other side of the street, or in front of your own garage? If you have visitors, maybe you can tell them where to park.

I hope we can solve this problem together and keep our good relationship as neighbours. Please let me know if you want to talk about it.

Best regards,
Min-jun

criteria.name: Content and task completion
criteria.strengths: You describe the problem, explain how it affects you and suggest two solutions, so every point in the task is covered.
criteria.improve: Add one sentence that shows you understand your neighbour's side before you make the request.

criteria.name: Organisation and coherence
criteria.strengths: The email moves clearly from the problem to its effect and then to a solution.
criteria.improve: Start the second paragraph with a linking phrase such as 'To avoid this in the future'.

criteria.name: Vocabulary range and precision
criteria.strengths: Words like 'driveway', 'visitors' and 'relationship' fit the situation well.
criteria.improve: Replace 'is not happy' with a more precise phrase such as 'was frustrated'.

criteria.name: Grammar and readability
criteria.strengths: Most sentences are easy to read and the tone is polite.
criteria.improve: Check verb forms after 'was' and 'since', and articles before vowel sounds.

topErrors.original: your car was block the way
topErrors.correction: your car was blocking the way
topErrors.why: Use the -ing form after 'was' to describe an action in progress.
Use 'an' before a word that starts with a vowel sound.
'Especially' means 'most of all'; 'specially' means 'for a special purpose'.

rewrites: Since last month, your car has been parked in front of my driveway about three times a week.
Yesterday your car was blocking my driveway, so I was late for an important meeting.
outputs.nextStep: Rewrite the second paragraph with the corrected verb forms, then read it aloud to check the tone.
